title: Light Alpine macaroni with ham and apple sauce
steps: Dice the potatoes and cook them with the pasta in salted water until al dente, then drain.
Peel and dice the apples and cook with 3 tbsp water until soft for a sauce.
Slice the onion into rings and fry slowly in the oil for 8–10 minutes until golden.
Dice the ham, add it to the pasta with the milk, cottage cheese and grated cheese and heat while stirring, then season.
Top with the onions and serve with the apple sauce.
